transcript.heard: 120 Christian countries around the world. How many are Jewish? Pew counted 201 countries and territories, every place with at least 100,000 people. Christian majority, 120. Muslim majority, 53. No religion, 10. Buddhist, seven. Hindu, two. And Jewish majority, hold that thought. Now the flags. 64 national flags carry a religious symbol. That's about one in three. 31 have a cross, like Britain, Greece and Norway, 21 of a Muslim symbol like Turkey and Algeria, and one flag has a star of David right between two blue stripes, one Jewish majority country out of 201, one Jewish flag. A cross or a crescent on a flag doesn't make a country unfree. Laws do. If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Ross for more. So when someone says the world has one Jewish state too many, ask them.
